content: Where there is mercy, there is righteousness. Where there is greed, there is sin. Where there is anger, there is death. Where there is forgiveness, there is God.
author: Kabir
explanation: Kabir maps the emotional geometry of spiritual life: greed and anger contract the heart into destruction, while active forgiveness and mercy expand the soul into direct communion with the Divine.
practicalInsight: When someone triggers resentment in you today, pause and deliberately extend silent forgiveness before choosing how to respond.
reflectionPrompt: Which grudge am I holding that is poisoning my own spiritual sanctuary?
